queue_model.description: Open arrival finite-horizon multiserver stage model. Service times and concurrency capacity are assumptions, not measured CockroachDB performance. Queue service demand is modeled wall-clock slot occupancy, not CPU time.

hardware_candidate.notes: Load-test candidate for full-scale rehearsal, NOT a measured sizing recommendation. Pilot starts 3 nodes per region; production size depends on measured vCPU, IOPS, compaction and failure headroom.

targets.name: Regional party lookup
targets.boundary: Regional gateway ingress to response; approved indexed ID lookup; no WAN authority call

targets.name: Bounded relationship view
targets.boundary: Regional gateway to response; at most 50 rows / 32 KiB; keyset page history/holdings

targets.name: Local business commit + outbox
targets.boundary: Regional gateway to durable local success; bounded transaction; does not wait for remote projection

targets.name: Approved federation visibility
targets.boundary: Owner commit to recipient query visibility; healthy WAN/cells; eligible destinations only

targets.name: Revocation enforced at recipient
targets.boundary: Owner restriction commit to denied reads; priority epoch channel plus max 5s authority lease incl. clock budget; proposed design

targets.name: Live projection purge acknowledgement
targets.boundary: Healthy recipient; retained audit/backups excluded; outage purge reported as pending

notes: Party participation totals 125M edges for 100M relationships: average 1.25 parties per relationship
80% uniform party events + 20% degree-weighted events; synthetic stress assumption
Optimized route count assumes canonical shared-resource delta at no more than two remote physical stores, plus recipient-scoped checks; not implemented in the PoC
Without this resource-level deduplication, ordinary deltas still have the baseline destination-job fanout
Assumed 180ms median WAN RTT and 250ms debounce, not measured transport
Visibility includes source planning, WAN, recipient commit and query refresh; excludes offline receivers
Deny distribution assumes 1% invalidation-path failure and a 5s residual authority lease; maximum is an engineered guarantee only with bounded clock skew and fail-closed expiry
Purge means live operational projection, not backup/audit deletion
No 100M-row database was loaded. Populations are analytic cardinality/storage models; workload is sampled discrete-event arrivals.
Results assume indexed, bounded reads/writes, connection pools, resource epochs, local authorisation and deduplicated delta propagation. These are proposed improvements, not current PoC behavior.
Independent lognormal demands, Poisson arrivals; separate scenarios cover selected correlations but not a full disk/CPU/compaction model.
Percentiles are medians of three run-specific percentiles; min/max is seed variability, NOT a confidence interval or model uncertainty interval.
Timeout threshold is reported as over-1s share. Simulation keeps those requests in queues instead of censoring them; no retries/aborts are triggered by client deadline.
Unstable scenarios are finite-horizon overload illustrations, not steady-state latency forecasts.
Lower scales use the same full-scale synthetic capacity with proportionately lower traffic. This is not a pilot hardware sizing test.
